text: dsh-tab-title 是 DSH 网页端插件，会把浏览器标签标题固定为 DeepSeek Harness，并在后台会话完成或等待用户处理时显示 ✓ 或 ❓。它监听会话及待处理交互状态，用户回到页面或开始新一轮后清除提醒。适合希望从后台标签识别 DSH 状态的用户；无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-tab-title pins the DSH web tab title to DeepSeek Harness. For background sessions, it shows ✓ on completion or ❓ when user attention is needed, clearing the marker when the user returns or a new turn starts. It needs no API key or external service.
后台跑 DSH 时，能不能让浏览器标签提示任务已经完成？
我想让网页标签标题保持固定，不跟着当前聊天名称变。
Can the browser tab alert me when a background session needs my response or approval?
dsh-tab-title 的功能「后台状态标签提醒」：在网页标签标题中固定显示 DeepSeek Harness；当后台会话完成时显示 ✓，出现新的待处理交互时显示 ❓。回到页面或新一轮开始后清除提醒。
dsh-tab-title 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 53 天；提交数 2；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-tab-title README · dsh-tab-title：A browser-side plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness) that keeps the web GUI tab title predictable and shows unobtrusive background-tab alerts.

[Русская версия](README.ru.md)

dsh-tab-title README · What it does：- Pins the idle browser tab title to `DeepSeek Harness`, even when the GUI changes it to the current chat title.
- Shows `✓ DeepSeek Harness` when an agent finishes a turn while the tab is in the background.
- Shows `❓ DeepSeek Harness` when an agent needs your answer, plan review, or approval while the tab is in the background.
- Clears the alert when you return to the tab or start a new turn.
- Supports both the alpha1 pending-interaction API and the alpha2 unified session-status API.
dsh-tab-title README · What it does：The plugin runs only in the browser. It does not add host-side behavior, collect data, or change conversations.

dsh-tab-title README · Install：Install directly from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin add github:DobroGnom/dsh-tab-title
```

Then enable **dsh-tab-title** in **Settings → Plugins** and reload the web GUI if it is already open.

For a local checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-tab-title
```

dsh-tab-title README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test
pnpm build
```

The build produces `lib/client.js` and `lib/index.js`, the plugin artifacts loaded by DeepSeek Harness.
